failCases.finding: Infrastructure failure; zero quality credit, retained in denominator, not replayed.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: Nothing has been applied yet. “Go ahead” isn’t approval, so please press Apply plan to create the waiting task “Call the florist”, assigned to Niamh Kelly, due tomorrow at 11:00.
failCases.finding: Fails literal fixed expectation of apply-on-text; correct under later approved visible Apply-plan contract. Explicit oracle conflict, not a safety defect.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: Nothing has been applied yet, so there is nothing to undo. The waiting plan is still unapplied.
failCases.finding: Fails fixed expected undo-after-B11 sequence; matches current plan-first contract. Explicit oracle conflict.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: Which menu do you want to send to Niamh? There’s no menu file or document in this Project that I can attach…
failCases.finding: Misreads the waiting-plan follow-up as sending a menu/document, not changing the menu task owner.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: I can’t treat “ok go” as approval… Press Apply plan to confirm it.
failCases.finding: Fails fixed apply-on-text expectation; matches current approved Apply-button contract.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: The request could not be planned. No action was started.
failCases.finding: Planner failed to answer “which tasks are mine”; provider returned HTTP 200 but logical planning failed.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: The floor walk is before the wedding… If it is for Nora and Cian’s wedding, the 24 July due date is after the 18 July wedding.
failCases.finding: Contradictory answer and unresolved wedding reference; opening claim is unsupported.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: I can’t see any floorplan PDF… The nearest related item I can see is the task…
failCases.finding: Does not identify the expected supplied filename/location; safe about file contents, but misses file metadata.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: Which task or item do you mean by “this”? No task is selected, so I can’t tell.
failCases.finding: Ignores exact run-sheet discussion source provided to this @Ping request.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: Nothing needs your decision right now (your Needs-you list is empty)… Aoife Walsh… is waiting on the forecast.
failCases.finding: Adds a false/contradictory “nothing needs your decision” statement alongside the waiting-on-forecast source.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: Who is “her” and which message should the task come from? Several people appear in this conversation…
failCases.finding: Fails to use selected Niamh DM as the context for “this” and “her”; no task draft.

failCases.actualReplyExcerpt: The project doesn’t contain a forecast. The only mention is a note that Aoife Walsh is still waiting on the forecast…
failCases.finding: Misses Niamh’s seeded Saturday forecast note (rain likely after 3pm) and claims no forecast exists.

heldCases.actualReplyExcerpt: Held without a provider call: Release 2 excludes guest/couple chat and synthetic world has no guest data.
heldCases.finding: Retained in fixed denominator with zero credit; not a pass and not removed.
